intermediate.name: Collada de Brenes
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (1) Collada de Brenes (122 km)

story: A massive 53-rider breakaway forms in the first half of the race but shatters on the Collada de Brenes. Ayuso and Romo crest the climb first, with Ayuso winning the sprint between them. The favourites’ group remains inactive.
